bio: Meet Sunny. Years behind the chair and thousands of fades later, he packed the whole shop into a kit and took it mobile across Ubud. Classic barbering, clean lines, and a finish that actually holds.

His thing is the details: fades that blend seamless, beards mapped to your face, and a straight-razor finish that feels like a proper ritual. One client at a time, full focus, and the chair comes to you.

services.name: Haircut
services.description: Consultation, a sharp scissor or clipper cut and style with premium products, finished with a clean neck shave.

services.name: Beard Trim
services.description: Shape-up and straight-razor edging, mapped to your face and finished with beard oil or balm.

services.name: Haircut & Beard
services.description: The full reset. Everything in the haircut, plus a complete beard sculpt, fresh head to chin.

services.name: Razor Shave
services.description: A traditional straight-razor shave with warm pre-shave oil and a cooling balm. Close, smooth and precise.
